result.reasoning: This commit introduced the maxSizeBeforeFirstWrap/maxSizeAfterFirstWrap alignment logic in setHalfwayBuffer that unconditionally rounded bufferSize down to a multiple of atracBytesPerFrame, even when readSize exceeded the aligned size (causing the buffer to be smaller than the actual read data). The fix commit adds a guard (only apply alignment if readSize < bufferSize and the aligned size is still >= readSize) to correct exactly this defect, directly modifying the same lines added by e98ea09934ce.
